All that you need to know about Coding Track - NITS Hacks 9.0
"Programming isn’t about what you know; it’s about what you can figure out."
Join the prestigious Coding Track - NITS Hacks 9.0, the annual algorithmic challenge organized by the National Institute of Technology (NIT), Silchar!
Whether you’re a coding genius or a newbie, this online challenge gives you the perfect chance to experience a high-stakes ICPC-style contest and showcase your programming skills. Form your strongest team and push your limits. Get ready for the adrenaline rush, the pressure, and the thrill of cracking problems under time!
 
Event Details:
  • Format: ICPC style
  • Problem Count: 12-14
  • Contest Window: 10 Nov 2026, 8:30 pm - 11 Nov 2026, 12:30 am
  • Duration: 4 hours
  • Mode: Online
  • Participation Fee: Free
  • Team Size: 2-3 Members
Eligibility and Registration:
  • Everyone is welcome to participate, but only undergraduate students enrolled in Bachelor’s or dual degree programs in India are eligible to receive prizes.
  • A team of 2-3 members from the same college is required to participate in the contest.
  • Teams must be registered on the contest platform, consisting of the verified accounts of all team members.
  • An eligible individual may join only one team.
  • All teams are required to join the official WhatsApp group after registration to receive further updates. Coding Track
Important Announcement - Mandatory Screen and Webcam Recording: To ensure a fair and transparent contest environment and minimize the chances of unfair practices such as plagiarism, all participants are required to record their entire screen for the full 4-hour duration of the contest using OBS Studio.To remain eligible for any prizes, participants must:
  • Record their full screen, webcam, and audio for the complete duration of the contest (4 hours) using OBS.
  • Upload the recordings to Google Drive and ensure the access is set to public.
  • Submit the Google Drive link on the event page within 2 hours after the contest ends.
  • Keep the recordings publicly accessible for at least 7 days after the contest.
  • Please note: All members of the team must record individually, i.e., for a team of 2, both participants must record; for a team of 3, all three participants must record.
  • A detailed OBS setup guide is provided in the given link: OBS Guide Link
Failure to submit the required recordings within the given time window will lead to ineligibility for prizes. Your cooperation is essential in maintaining a fair and competitive contest environment.We look forward to seeing your skill, determination, and problem-solving excellence in action. Let the leaderboard speak for the teams!
